description:
Situated in the heart of Darlington. This well-presented two-bedroom terraced property offers an excellent opportunity for first-time buyers, small families or investors.

LOUNGE Double glazed upvc windows, radiator and chimney breast

RECEPTION ROOM Ample second reception room, double glazed upvc window overlooking the rear courtyard, under stairs storage and door leading into the kitchen.

KITCHEN White wall and base units with contrasting black work surfaces, plumbing for a washing machine and space for an oven. Upvc double glazed window overlooking the rear courtyard.

BATHROOM Fully panelled bathroom, bath with overhead electric shower and glass shower screen. Low rice WC with wash and hand basin.

MASTER BEDROOM Spacious master bedroom to the front of the property. Double glazed upvc window and radiator. Fitted over head storage and wardrobes.

BEDROOM TWO Double bedroom, upvc double glazed window with radiator, storage cupboard over the stairs.

EXTERNAL Externally the property boasts a rear courtyard painted grey with external water tap fitted to the wall.
